THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER 1.

Accused nos.1 to 3 in Crime No.185/2023 registered by Byndoor Police Station, Udupi District, for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 417, 420, 506, 34 IPC, are before this Court under Section 438 Cr.PC.
2. Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.
3. Complainant had approached Byndoor police of Udupi District on 16.10.2023 and had lodged a complaint, wherein it is averred that the complainant is running a shop known as Comfort Mini Super Market in Byndoor and she had availed Overdraft Loan from Canara Bank.

The accused persons after knowing about the sanction of loan, had approached the NC: 2023:KHC:40955 complainant and had requested for financial assistance with an assurance that they will repay the amount within two months.

As per the request made by the accused persons, complainant allegedly had transferred totally a sum of Rs.15 lakhs to the account of the petitioner nos.1 & 2 during the period from 15.06.2021 to 18.06.2021 through bank transactions.

When the complainant had thereafter approached the accused persons demanding repayment of the amount availed by them,

sentences.text: the accused persons allegedly abused and criminally intimidated the complainant.
It is in this background, the complainant had lodged the complaint, which had resulted in registering FIR in Crime No.185/2023 by Byndoor police against the petitioners.
Apprehending arrest in the said case

,
petitioners had filed Crl. Misc. No.705/2023 before the Addl. District & Sessions Judge, Udupi (sitting at Kundapura), which was dismissed on 04.11.2023.
Therefore, they are before this Court.
4. Learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that there is a dispute between the parties with regard to certain financial transactions.
The complainant has already initiated proceedings against the petitioners under Section 138 of the Negotiable NC: 2023:KHC:40955 Instruments Act.
Petitioner no.1 has got issued a legal notice to the complainant claiming damages for defamation.
He submits that the alleged offences are triable by the Court of Magistrate and the maximum punishment for the alleged offences is imprisonment by seven years.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.
He submits that investigation in the case is under progress and accordingly, prays to dismiss the petition.
6. The material on record would go to show that there is a financial dispute between the parties to the present case.

The complainant's husband had earlier initiated proceedings under Section 138 of the N.I.Act against the accused persons and inturn accused no.1 had issued a legal notice to the complainant's husband claiming damages for defamation.
The present complaint is subsequently filed making allegations that the accused persons have availed financial assistance from the complainant.

Considering the nature of allegations made in the complaint and in the back drop of the earlier litigation between the parties, a serious doubt arises with regard to the NC:
2023:KHC:40955 genuineness of the allegations made in the complaint.
The alleged offences against the petitioners are triable by the court of Magistrate and the maximum punishment for the alleged offences is imprisonment by seven years.
Under the said circumstances, I am of the opinion that the petitioners have made out a case for grant of anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the following order:
7. The petition is allowed.

The respondent - Police or any other police in the State of Karnataka are directed to release the petitioners in the event of their arrest in Crime No.185/2023 registered by Byndoor Police Station, Udupi District, for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 417, 420,
506, 34 IPC, subject to the following conditions:
1. The Petitioners shall appear before the Investigating Officer within 15 days from the date of receipt of the copy of this order and shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
each with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
